name: AI Hedge Fund
description: Educational multi-agent hedge fund simulator in which investor-persona agents analyse stocks and a portfolio manager decides trades.
whatItDoes: Demonstrates how a team of agents could research and trade stocks, with paper trading and backtesting modes. It places no real orders and is meant for learning.
howItWorks: Agents with different investing styles plus valuation, sentiment, fundamentals and risk roles produce signals that a portfolio manager combines. The CLI prompts for a financial data key and one model key on first run and stores them in a local env file.

requirements.name: LLM provider API key
requirements.description: One of Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Google, xAI or Kimi

models: Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Google, xAI, Kimi
